title: Game of Thrones - Luismi
text: Our trip to Cadiz was amazing! Luismi was our tour guide and he was fantastic. He was tremendously knowledgeable and explained everything so well. My title Game of Thrones was because he knew Spanish history so well and tied everything together for us! Must do!
author: Rob_R

title: Cádiz/Jerez Spring 2024
text: Our guide Luismi was extremely knowledgeable and very personable. We thoroughly enjoyed visiting Cadiz. In Cadiz we loved the Roman theater and the Cadiz Malecón. Also the winery bodega and tasting was excellent.
author: Ana_B

title: Good tour
text: This was a good tour with a fantastic guide.  My only issue was with a 10:30am wine tasting.  I would have preferred to flip that schedule and done Cadiz first.
author: Beth_K
